template.name: FT CCI
template.notes: CCI is not in the DSL, so it is approximated by the z-score of typical price over the documented CCI Period 14 and the upper/lower thresholds are taken as the conventional +/-100 CCI levels, i.e. +/-1 z; an upward cross out of the lower band is the long entry and the mirror cross is the exit. The pip-based Stop Loss and Take Profit (0 disables each) and the 30-minute CandleType are not expressible.
